Propel Stainless Steel Flask – 380ml Thermal Insulated Water Bottle

The Propel Stainless Steel Flask is designed for people who value durability, performance, and style in their everyday hydration solutions. With a capacity of 380ml, this compact and lightweight flask is ideal for daily use, travel, office, gym, or outdoor activities. Crafted using high-quality stainless steel, it delivers excellent temperature retention while maintaining a sleek and modern look.

Featuring advanced thermal insulation, the Propel Stainless Steel Flask keeps your drinks hot or cold for several hours. Whether you are carrying hot coffee during morning commutes or chilled water on a summer day, this flask ensures your beverage stays at the desired temperature for longer periods.

Premium Build with Long-Lasting Performance

Made from food-grade stainless steel, the Propel Stainless Steel Flask is resistant to rust, stains, and odors. Its robust construction makes it suitable for daily wear and tear while ensuring safe and hygienic storage of beverages. The 380ml capacity offers the perfect balance between portability and adequate hydration, making it a preferred choice for professionals, students, and travelers.

Thermal Insulation That Works

The double-wall insulation technology used in the Propel Stainless Steel Flask helps maintain the internal temperature of liquids for several hours. This feature prevents condensation on the outer surface and ensures a comfortable grip at all times. Enjoy hot beverages without burning your hands or cold drinks without moisture buildup.

Detachable Lid for Convenience and Hygiene

A key highlight of the Propel Stainless Steel Flask is its detachable lid. The lid is designed for easy opening, cleaning, and refilling, helping maintain hygiene and convenience. The leak-resistant design ensures worry-free usage inside bags, backpacks, or handbags.

Elegant Colour Options

The Propel Stainless Steel Flask is available in classic Colours – Black and White. These timeless shades complement both professional and casual lifestyles, making the flask suitable for corporate gifting, promotional use, or personal ownership. The minimalist finish adds a premium look that stands out without being flashy.

Key Features of Propel Stainless Steel Flask

  • Product Name: Propel Stainless Steel Flask
  • Capacity: 380ml – compact and travel-friendly
  • Material: High-quality stainless steel
  • Thermal Insulation: Keeps drinks hot or cold for several hours
  • Detachable Lid: Easy to clean and refill
  • Leak-Resistant Design for safe carrying
  • Available in Colour: Black and White
  • Ideal for office, travel, gym, and outdoor use

Why Choose?

The stands out due to its combination of durability, efficient insulation, and elegant design. Unlike ordinary bottles, it preserves the taste and temperature of beverages without compromising on portability. The 380ml capacity is perfect for controlled hydration while minimizing bulk.

This stainless steel is an eco-friendly alternative to single-use plastic bottles and supports sustainable living. Its reusable design makes it a smart choice for environmentally conscious consumers who seek long-term value.

Perfect for Multiple Use Cases

Whether you are heading to work, traveling, or engaging in fitness activities, the adapts to every lifestyle. It is also suitable for gifting purposes, brand promotions, and corporate giveaways due to its premium finish and universal appeal.

Choose the Propel Stainless Steel Flask, Capacity: 380ml, for reliable thermal insulation, easy maintenance with a detachable lid, and a modern design available in black and white. A perfect blend of functionality and elegance for everyday hydration.
